test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A spherical mirror forms an erect and diminished image. Identify the correct statement(s) about the spherical mirror.

(A) The mirror is concave.

(B) The mirror forms a virtual image.

(C) The mirror has positive focal length.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both B and C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Spherical Mirror Characteristics:**

 
• **Convex Mirror:** A convex mirror always forms a virtual, erect, and diminished image, regardless of the position of the object. It has a positive focal length.
 
• **Concave Mirror:** A concave mirror can form real and inverted images as well as virtual and erect images, depending on the position of the object. However, it forms a virtual, erect, and magnified image when the object is between the focal point and the mirror.
 
• Given that the mirror forms an erect and diminished image, it must be a **convex mirror** since concave mirrors do not produce diminished erect images.
 
• Convex mirrors always form **virtual images** that are diminished and erect.
 
• Convex mirrors have a **positive focal length**.
 
• Hence, based on the above points:
 
 
• Statement B is correct because the mirror forms a virtual image.
 
• Statement C is correct because the mirror has a positive focal length.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct statements are B and C, making Option 4 the correct answer.**
